text:
### 3.3 Dormancy  
If your account has:
- No activity (deposits or withdrawals) for 12 months, AND
- No customer contact for 12 months  
Your account becomes "dormant." We will:
1. Send letter to last known address
2. Mark account as dormant (no impact on you)
3. Continue accruing interest
4. Maintain full access (deposit/withdrawal possible)

raw_entities.name: Dormancy Policy
raw_entities.description: Defines the conditions and procedures for account dormancy. An account becomes dormant after 12 months of no activity (deposits or withdrawals) and no customer contact. The bank will notify the customer by letter to their last known address, mark the account as dormant, and continue accruing interest while maintaining full customer access.
context: If your account has: No activity (deposits or withdrawals) for 12 months, AND No customer contact for 12 months Your account becomes "dormant."
We will: 1. Send letter to last known address 2. Mark account as dormant (no impact on you) 3. Continue accruing interest 4. Maintain full access (deposit/withdrawal possible)

raw_entities.name: Dormancy Trigger Condition
raw_entities.description: Specifies the dual conditions that trigger dormancy status: no deposits or withdrawals for 12 months AND no customer contact for 12 months. Both conditions must be met simultaneously for dormancy to be activated.
context: No activity (deposits or withdrawals) for 12 months, AND No customer contact for 12 months

raw_entities.name: Continued Interest Accrual During Dormancy
raw_entities.description: Ensures that customer accounts continue to accrue interest even after being marked as dormant, protecting the customer's earnings on their balance.

raw_entities.name: Full Access Maintenance During Dormancy
raw_entities.description: Guarantees that customers retain full deposit and withdrawal access to their dormant accounts, ensuring dormancy status does not restrict account functionality.
